**STEP 1 - Scene:** A tray meal with three components: tortellini in tomato sauce, roasted baby potatoes, and mixed vegetables (carrot, broccoli, corn). A glass of juice is also on the tray, but it is a drink, so I left it out of the food estimate.

**STEP 2 - Vessels:** Tortellini on a side plate (~20 cm, area ~314 cm²). Potatoes on a second side plate (~20 cm, area ~314 cm²). Vegetables in a cereal bowl (~15 cm, area ~177 cm²).

**STEP 3 - Items:** Tortellini, tomato sauce, mixed vegetables, baby potatoes with herbs.

**STEP 4 - Area:**
- Tortellini: ~45% of the tortellini plate (~141 cm²)
- Tomato sauce: ~10% of the tortellini plate (~31 cm²)
- Mixed vegetables: ~70% of the bowl (~124 cm²)
- Potatoes: ~30% of the potato plate (~94 cm²)

**STEP 5 - Volume:**
- Tortellini: 141 cm² × 2 cm ≈ 282 ml
- Sauce: 31 cm² × 0.5 cm ≈ 16 ml
- Vegetables: 124 cm² × 1.5 cm ≈ 186 ml
- Potatoes: 94 cm² × 2 cm ≈ 188 ml

**STEP 6 - Grams:**
- Tortellini: 282 ml × 0.8 ≈ 226 g, rounded to 220 g
- Sauce: 16 g
- Vegetables: 186 ml × 0.6 ≈ 112 g
- Potatoes: 188 ml × 0.9 ≈ 169 g, rounded to 160 g

**STEP 7 - Energy:**
- Tortellini: 220 g × 200 kcal/100 g ≈ 440 kcal
- Sauce: 16 g × 40 kcal/100 g ≈ 6 kcal
- Vegetables: 112 g × 35 kcal/100 g ≈ 39 kcal
- Potatoes: 160 g × 85 kcal/100 g ≈ 136 kcal

**STEP 8 - Sanity check:** Total ≈ 508 g and ≈ 621 kcal. That is plausible for a full tray with a generous pasta portion, two side plates and a bowl of vegetables. The estimate excludes the juice.
